import pytest
from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment

def test_loop_index_in_block_native_env():
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = env.from_string('{% block test %}{% for i in range(1) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}')
    # The original bug caused a TypeError because loop.index (an int) was passed to native_concat
    # without being converted to a string first when rendered inside a block and then called.
    # The expected output is the integer 1, as native_concat should handle single integer results.
    assert template.render() == 1

def test_loop_index_in_block_native_env_multiple_iterations():
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = env.from_string('{% block test %}{% for i in range(3) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}')
    # With multiple iterations, the result should be a concatenated string "123"
    assert template.render() == "123"

def test_loop_index_directly_native_env():
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = env.from_string('{% for i in range(1) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}')
    # Directly rendering loop.index should also work and return the integer 1
    assert template.render() == 1

def test_loop_index_directly_native_env_multiple_iterations():
    env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = env.from_string('{% for i in range(3) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}')
    # Directly rendering multiple loop.index should return the concatenated string "123"
    assert template.render() == "123"
